hypothesis: Shared/reduced procedures improve recent validation years but not the 2022 high-volatility fold. Fixed training-only recency weighting tests temporal drift rather than relaxing gates or tuning on test.
selection: Zero and v2 are always eligible. New candidates require pooled chronological validation RMSE at least 0.1% lower than best zero/v2 and lower RMSE in at least three of four years. Then minimum pooled RMSE; ties prefer candidate order.
normalization: Only current decision-time causal EWM volatility, clipped at 1e-5; returns/peer return divided by scale, momenta divided by scale times sqrt horizon; normalized training targets y/scale; predictions multiplied by current saved scale.
training: Each chronological fold purges any training label maturing on or after its first validation decision; scaler fits only fold training rows. Pooled fit stacks assets but never shuffles future dates into training.
test: Observed 2026 snapshots; descriptive only, no candidate selection from test. If v2 retained, do not rescore 2026. If procedure changes, freeze selection before one replay, retaining fixed v2 comparison.
disclosure: All periods have been observed previously. This retrospective model development cannot establish independent generalization, guaranteed coverage, returns or profit. Shared CAD exposures induce correlation; pooling changes effective penalty and is a procedure comparison.
recency: Weights decay from the latest TRAINING target publication date only. Mean-normalize weights to one; fit scaler and ridge with the same sample weights. No validation/test date or label determines a training weight.
